---
title: "Subnational Index Demo"
author: "Gustavo Marangoni"
format: beamer
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)

load("SDI (v.1).RData")

df <- 
  data_sdi |> 
  filter(region_name == 'SUDESTE')
```

# Analysis Slide
```{r}
#Graph dem by region by time
df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = SUR_index_sub_exe,
             color = state_name)) +
  geom_line() +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x = "Year", 
    y = "Subnational Democracy Index Score",
    title = "Democracy Index on the Sudeste Region in Brazil Over Time",
    color = "State"
  )

```
